name: 科学史时间线

prompt_template.subject: {history_topic}
prompt_template.layout: horizontal timeline with milestone markers along a central axis
prompt_template.style: editorial timeline with event cards alternating above and below axis
prompt_template.color_scheme: chronological gradient or era-based color coding
prompt_template.labels: year in bold, event title in semibold, description in regular, icons per event

defaults.layout: horizontal timeline with alternating event cards

editorial.description: 杂志编辑风格，卡片交替

overrides.layout: horizontal timeline with event cards alternating above/below central axis

vertical.description: 垂直时间线，适合长历史

overrides.layout: vertical timeline top-to-bottom with event cards on right side

winding.description: 蜿蜒路径时间线，趣味性

overrides.layout: winding road timeline with milestones as signposts along curved path

periodic.description: 分期色块时间线，按时代分段

overrides.layout: horizontal axis divided into era color blocks with events within each era

category_tips.biology: 演化时间线用地质年代色块；物种出现标 mya；灭绝事件用红色标记
category_tips.medicine: 医学发现时间线标注研究者和国籍；诺贝尔奖年份标记
category_tips.chemistry: 元素发现时间线按周期表位置着色；诺贝尔化学奖标记
category_tips.physics: 物理学里程碑按经典/近代/现代分期；公式标注关键事件
category_tips.engineering: 技术演进按工业革命分期；专利年份标注
category_tips.math: 数学定理按古代/中世纪/近代分期；数学家肖像图标

examples: Horizontal timeline of DNA discovery, central axis with 6 milestones: (1869) Miescher isolates DNA, (1953) Watson & Crick double helix, (1977) Sanger sequencing, (1990) Human Genome Project starts, (2003) HGP completion, (2020) CRISPR therapeutics. Event cards alternating above/below axis, year in bold, event title semibold, description regular, icon per event (microscope, helix, sequencer). Chronological gradient blue #3b82f6 to green #10b981. 4K, editorial style.

Vertical timeline of artificial intelligence history, top-to-bottom. 8 milestones from (1950) Turing Test to (2024) Large Language Models. Event cards on right side with year, title, description, and researcher portrait icon. Era color blocks: Symbolic AI blue, Connectionism green, Deep Learning purple, LLM era orange. Bilingual labels 深度学习 (Deep Learning). 4K.

Winding road timeline of space exploration, curved path from (1957) Sputnik to (2024) Mars missions. Milestones as signposts along the path with rocket icons. Space-themed palette black background with white text and accent colors per decade. 4K, popular science style.
accuracy_tips: 年份和历史事件准确无误；研究者姓名和国籍正确；不虚构历史事件或人物；关键里程碑按时间顺序排列；时代分期标注清晰；中文译名采用通用译法。
